data_fields.name: hub_id
data_fields.donor_constant: town id (uint32, read from map file)

data_fields.name: hub_temple_position
data_fields.donor_constant: x, y, z from the map file

best_idea: Treat each zone's hub (name, temple position) as a data record, and have login, death, and floor-loss rules all resolve to it, refusing a character whose hub is unknown rather than guessing a spawn.
decision_why: Adopt the hub-as-data record and refuse-on-unknown-hub; adapt the death order so the respawn is set on the server first and does not wait for a client re-login, which the donor relies on.
acceptance: A player who dies in zone A is placed at zone A's hub temple on the server with no client round trip; a server test asserts a character whose hub id is missing is refused at login, and a removed floor under a player moves that player to the hub.
